g.text: Lower is faster. All axes use the same log scale.
Whiskers: observed replicate range, not a confidence interval.
† Shading: native root filter proves this rejection.
LIMIT/other labels: no completed comparison; no point plotted.
Plan 4 forces task grain 0; Default 4 retains 4096 bytes.
Configured workers can exceed the number actually used.
